by
  intro N x
  have hclosed : Real.sin (x / 2) ≠ 0 → ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x)) = (Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * x / 2) / Real.sin (x / 2)) ^ 2 := by
    intro hx
    have hD : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = Real.sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) / Real.sin (x / 2) := by
      intro n
      rw [eq_div_iff hx]
      induction n with
      | zero => simp; ring_nf
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ← add_assoc, add_mul, ih]
        have h1 : Real.sin (((n + 1 : ℕ) + 1 / 2 : ℝ) * x) = Real.sin ((((n : ℝ) + 1) * x) + x / 2) := by
          push_cast; ring_nf
        have h2 : Real.sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) = Real.sin ((((n : ℝ) + 1) * x) - x / 2) := by
          ring_nf
        rw [h1, h2, Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub]
        ring
    simp only [hD]
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ N ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, div_pow, div_pow]
      have h1 : Real.sin (((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * x / 2) = Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * x / 2 + x / 2) := by
        push_cast; ring_nf
      have h2 : Real.sin (((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) = Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * x / 2 + ((N : ℝ) * x / 2 + x / 2)) := by
        ring_nf
      rw [h1, h2, Real.sin_add ((N : ℝ) * x / 2) ((N : ℝ) * x / 2 + x / 2), Real.sin_add ((N : ℝ) * x / 2) (x / 2), Real.cos_add ((N : ℝ) * x / 2) (x / 2)]
      have hc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (x / 2)
      field_simp
      linear_combination (-(Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * x / 2)) ^ 2) * hc
  refine ⟨hclosed, ?_⟩
  by_cases hx : Real.sin (x / 2) = 0
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hx
    have hcos : ∀ k : ℕ, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = 1 := by
      intro k
      have e : ((k : ℝ) + 1) * x = (((k : ℤ) + 1) * m : ℤ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        have hxm : x = 2 * ((m : ℝ) * Real.pi) := by linarith
        rw [hxm]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [e, Real.cos_int_mul_two_pi]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun n _ => ?_)
    simp only [hcos]
    positivity
  · rw [hclosed hx]
    positivity
target_source: ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ), (Real.sin (x / 2) ≠ 0 → ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x)) = (Real.sin ((N : ℝ) * x / 2) / Real.sin (x / 2)) ^ 2) ∧ 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x))
